question: Can physical KeyRelease be moved immediately after raw capture, while PNG save/fsync/reopen publication happens afterward, reducing hold time without changing the captured frame content?
fixture: Xvfb 1024x768x24 + Openbox + rendered Tk checkerboard + XTEST w key
common: 250 ms hold; at deadline take one full-frame ImageGrab before KeyRelease in both conditions; publish exactly that in-memory image as PNG with fsync and reopen/load
primary_metric: paired baseline(capture_publish_release)-candidate(capture_release_publish) application-observed hold duration in ms

decision.two_phase_candidate: median paired reduction >= 10 ms AND all raw capture pixel digests equal their reopened artifact pixel digests AND every candidate app KeyRelease timestamp precedes publication completion
decision.reject: any correctness/order invariant fails OR median paired reduction < 10 ms

construction_smoke: 2 pairs excluded; median paired reduction 19.2220085 ms; raw/reopen match 4/4; candidate release-before-publish 2/2
scope: development mechanism isolation only; no ViZDoom, gameplay efficacy, model, planner, renewal, or shared-runtime claim
